title: #351 Class Attendance
prompt: Some people believe that university students should be required to attend classes. Others believe that going to classes should be optional for students. Which point of view do you agree with?

promptSegments.text: Some people believe that university students should be required to attend classes.
Others believe that going to classes should be optional for students.
Which point of view do you agree with?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that good attendance helps students learn better by keeping them updated on lessons.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that good attendance helps students learn better by keeping them updated on lessons.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that attending class helps students meet their friends, which is important for social development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that attending class helps students meet their friends, which is important for social development.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that students should not be forced to attend school every day, presenting two main points: the need for occasional absence for health/family reasons, and the necessity of accommodating outside commitments like jobs or sports.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that students should not be forced to attend school every day, presenting two main points: the need for occasional absence for health/family reasons, and the necessity of accommodating outside commitments like jobs or sports.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay maintains a simple, direct tone, using basic connectors and short sentences suitable for A2-B1 learners. It successfully avoids complex vocabulary and advanced linking words, while adhering to the strict structural requirements (PEEL, sentence counts, etc.).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay maintains a simple, direct tone, using basic connectors and short sentences suitable for A2-B1 learners. It successfully avoids complex vocabulary and advanced linking words, while adhering to the strict structural requirements (PEEL, sentence counts, etc.).

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that regular attendance helps students learn better by ensuring they do not miss important information and practice.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that regular attendance helps students learn better by ensuring they do not miss important information and practice.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that good attendance helps students build better relationships with their teachers and classmates, improving the social side of school life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that good attendance helps students build better relationships with their teachers and classmates, improving the social side of school life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that mandatory class attendance is too restrictive, focusing instead on the benefits of flexible and remote learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that mandatory class attendance is too restrictive, focusing instead on the benefits of flexible and remote learning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay supports the view that students gain valuable life skills, such as time management and self-discipline, when they are not restricted to a physical classroom.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay supports the view that students gain valuable life skills, such as time management and self-discipline, when they are not restricted to a physical classroom.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
